Stack Rasters with Regular Spacing

Source: R/convenience.R
vrt_regular_stack.Rd

A convenience wrapper for gdal_mdim_stack() when files represent regularly spaced values (e.g., monthly data, hourly snapshots, uniform vertical levels).

Usage

vrt_regular_stack(
  files,
  dim_name,
  start,
  increment,
  unit = NULL,
  array_name = NULL,
  output = NULL
)

Arguments

files

Character vector of file paths, in order

dim_name

Name for the new dimension

start

Starting value

increment

Spacing between values

unit

Unit string

array_name

Name for the data array

output

Output VRT path

Value

Path to VRT file (invisibly), or XML string if output is NULL.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# 12 monthly files
vrt_regular_stack(
  files = sprintf("precip_%02d.tif", 1:12),
  dim_name = "month",
  start = 1,
  increment = 1,
  output = "monthly_precip.vrt"
)

# Pressure levels at 50 hPa intervals
vrt_regular_stack(
  files = level_files,
  dim_name = "pressure",
  start = 1000,
  increment = -50,
  unit = "hPa",
  output = "pressure_levels.vrt"
)
} # }
